typography.note: Type scale per platform. Same 9 named styles; iOS uses larger body sizes (17/15/13) than Android/Web (16/14/12). Weights: Display/Headline = Bold 700; *Bold = SemiBold 600; rest Regular 400.
typography.refiningNote: Refining Typography page 3076:2 (⏳) is the iOS SF Pro HIG scale (below). The 'styles' array is the PRODUCT scale (live UIKit baseline) the chat/feed inspector matches against — kept intact.

grid.note: 2x grid based on an 8-pixel square; elements follow the 8px grid

elevation.note: 8 shadow levels. 01 & 02 share the same value in the file. 01-07 use a grey-blue shadow (96,97,112)/(40,41,61); 08 uses pure black (3-layer).

breakpoint.description: Responsive breakpoints for UIKit 4.0 — three tiers; layout switches from mobile bottom-nav to desktop side-nav at 769px.

contentColumn.note: content column scales fluidly between these clamps

breakpoint.grid: none defined on this page — see layout tokens for the 16-column grid

footer.rule: Confirmation = Primary + Secondary; Acknowledgement = Primary only

alertDialog.note: iOS & Android variants exist on the same page with stacked/single-action footers; not documented here

main.note: Matrix is sparse — only the listed Hierarchy×Tone combinations exist. Note: this Button set uses Primary #3b41ec / Destructive #e50b1b, which differs from the Colors page Primary #1054de — confirm with the designer.

chips.note: Full-pill chips. Hover/Pressed add a subtle fill — exact tints not captured.

input.note: Underlined exists only at Medium. Font sizes identical across Medium/Small — only height/padding/radius differ.

Error.signal: border + helper recolour to error red

input.note2: Boxed border is #ebecef on Enabled/Focused/Disabled; only Error recolours to #fa4d30. Focus = Primary text cursor, not a border change.

keyboard.note: System keyboard reference — use the OS keyboard, reserve this height in layouts; heights are 375px-reference baselines and vary by device/language/suggestion strip.
